name: What interior renovations offer the best return on investment for my home?

mainEntity.name: What interior renovations offer the best return on investment for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen and bathroom remodels often provide the highest return on investment due to their impact on daily living and resale value. Updated kitchens and baths are key selling points. When planning, consider practical tradeoffs such as how long you plan to stay in the home; minor, cosmetic updates may suffice if you are selling soon, while a more extensive overhaul could be beneficial for long-term enjoyment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen and bathroom renovations typically offer the best return on investment. Consider your long-term plans to decide between minor updates or a full overhaul.
